scripts.build:android: npm run build:native && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run build:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk','public/downloads/Kairon.apk')"
scripts.build:native: node -e "if(!process.env.VITE_API_URL){console.error('Set VITE_API_URL to the hosted API, e.g. https://kairon-eight.vercel.app');process.exit(1)}" && npm run build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/downloads',{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.build:ios: npm run build:native && cap sync ios
